reuse.why: Adds the check to the existing accounts/link.ts module of shared link helpers (next to findOrCreateBank) and uses the existing BankSyncProviders type.

duplication.why: The rule is one function; each of the five provider link handlers only calls it with its provider and id.

placement.why: link.ts is where the tree keeps logic shared by the provider link handlers, and the call happens first in each handler so nothing is written before refusal.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: A small documented helper with a single query encoding the whole definition of 'linked'; easy to extend.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/link.ts, called by all five *-accounts-link handlers in accounts/app.ts.
